blocks.text: GENERAL SANTOS CITY– Renewable (RE) energy advocates have expressed confidence that Mindanao can be weaned away from its reliance on dirty, expensive fossil fuels to power its homes and industries by 50 percent by 2030, earlier than the rest of the country. Under the country’s nationally determined contribution to reducing global greenhouse gas emissions, Mindanao has set a target to make renewable energy half of the region’s energy mix by 2030, on par with fossil fuels, mainly coal.
